capabilities: show heading level markers in the editor gutter
switch a heading's level via a menu
reorder markers relative to line numbers
show heading levels in source mode
customize markers per heading level with CSS
disambiguation: It only adds level markers and a level-switching menu in the editor gutter; it does not change heading text styling itself, though CSS can target the markers.
extras: The README links a Ko-fi page for donations.
problem: In the editor, heading levels are hard to tell apart at a glance, especially when several levels look similar in rendered or source text.
summary: Editor gutter extension that displays a heading level marker (h1, h2, h3) next to each heading and offers a menu to switch heading levels.
